# Private proof-tool source inputs

Project: bboxy450-harness — https://github.com/bboxy450/bboxy450-harness
Credit copied/adapted/translated reuse accurately; independent inspiration credit requested.
Policy: https://github.com/bboxy450/bboxy450-harness/blob/main/ATTRIBUTION.md

`sources.lock.json` preserves the exact seven-source ICD pins, signed-byte forms,
public roots, certificate/signature hashes and frozen Q2 probe. Certificates and
signatures are unmodified primary-source bytes. `patches.lock.json` pins complete
patch bytes and every affected upstream preimage/postimage. Patches apply with
zero fuzz; their postimages are checked before compilation. Original source
notices and licenses stay under their upstream terms (`license-map.json`).

The Git guards authorize one real, fixed absolute GPG verification child from
the existing signature path, consume its attempt before effects, reject generic
commands and async fork/thread work, and disable ENOEXEC shell fallback. Building
with NO_PTHREADS also selects upstream synchronous paths; it is not a lifetime
proof. GnuPG guards reject secret packet dispatch, unsupported commands/keyboxd
and service connections. Secret packet tags refuse immediately after decoding,
before skip/copy paths. The public-only secret-presence query returns the actual
no-secret-key premise without consulting an agent, including nonexportable
signature handling; this requires an owned public-only home before birth. Actual public import,
revocation checks and signature verification remain upstream implementations.
The profile defaults autostart and automatic key location off, and rejects
unsupported retrieval/import/secret-display settings before helper initialization.
Compression and public signature algorithms retain upstream behavior; portable
Libgcrypt code changes its implementation choice, not the admitted algorithms.
Libgpg-error/Libassuan/nPth guards refuse process/thread creation at their source
seams. Libgcrypt selects upstream portable code with jitterentropy disabled.
Its additional startup guards refuse ambient hwf.deny/FIPS configuration before
reading it, and refuse optional syslog calls before socket/service effects.
These refusals preserve failure rather than a cryptographic success. Darwin
Git uses documented NO_HOMEBREW and removes its unused CoreServices framework;
actual generated flags and recursive loaded closure remain required evidence.

These patches are incomplete qualification work. Current-source tests check
pins, custody and finite models; the complete command/error/constructor/platform
closure review and actually executed real-tool mutants remain outstanding.
The focused source gate also compiles three mutations at the actual Git main
entry (fork, pthread_create and socket/connect), verifies that their input hashes
lose SOURCE qualification, and retains the object bytes. Those objects are never
linked or executed; this is distinct from a canonical native effect witness.
Greps, symbol inventories, versions, absence of installed daemons and successful
samples do not establish lifetime coverage.

The real six-source configure failure remains retained. Root amended the task
to append authenticated Libksba1.8.1, keeping all first-six pins/order and the
mandatory GnuPG KSBA check. Actual link maps decide whether KSBA is build-only or
linked; every linked member remains part of source/closure review. The old
canonical probe's native/ledger results are separate evidence and its Git mode
still refuses81. A new private-candidate mode requires Root's explicit source/
executable freeze before consumption. No builder result fills Q2's absent
Root-reviewed runtime admission literal or certifies a lesson.

Decision65960 B corrects the implicit signature operand to the matcher
`{git_signature_temp}`. `check --signature-corpus-only` exercises only the pinned
source/corpus byte equivalence, case/substitution controls and updated Commands
binding. It launches no Git/GPG/probe and creates no candidate. Its new Commands
hash invalidates old pending tuples. Shared closure and Root's coherent frozen
Q2 probe are still prerequisites for candidate regeneration and a real witness.
